title: WordTeX - A WYSIPCTWOTCG Typesetting Tool
summary: Tom Wildenhain's SIGBOVIK 2018 presentation of WordTeX, a Microsoft Word template that mimics LaTeX typesetting output. It is a joke research project executed with serious effort.
why: HN people recommend it as an entertaining example of great effort on a trivial problem, and cite the template in LaTeX-versus-Word discussions.

quote.text: this one on WordTeX is excellent
